title: Seedance2.5 Draft: Reference to Video
summary: Generate draft preview videos from reference images using Seedance 2.5's two-phase draft mode: stage one turns your references and prompt into a fast, low-cost 480p preview plus a reusable draft task ID, and stage two renders the 1080p final from that ID. Ideal for locking in a character or storyboard reference before committing to a full-quality render.
